data.label: Get More Calls
data.title:
5 website changes that
*bring more bookings*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site is ready →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Make your *phone number* clickable
data.body: Customers on mobile devices won't copy and paste your number. A clickable link makes calling you instant and easy.
data.fix: Fix: Add a tel: link to your phone number in HTML.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Add a *book now* button
data.body: Don't make people hunt for your contact form. A clear button helps you capture leads while you are busy working.
data.fix: Fix: Place a bright button in your top navigation bar.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Check your *mobile layout*
data.body: Most of your customers are searching for services on their phones. If it looks broken, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and test every button.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: List your *service area*
data.body: Clients need to know you work in their neighborhood. Being specific helps you avoid wasted calls from outside your reach.
data.fix: Fix: Write your cities and counties clearly on your homepage.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Show *customer reviews*
data.body: New clients trust what others say about you more than your own marketing. Social proof builds instant trust.
data.fix: Fix: Add three recent Google reviews to your main page.
